title: Missing Slippage Protection in claim()
description: The claim() function lacks slippage protection parameters such as minOutput or maxPayment. Users cannot specify acceptable bounds for the transaction outcome, leaving them vulnerable to front-running and rate changes during transaction execution.
impact: Claimers can be front-run by MEV bots or experience unexpected losses if exchange rates or reward calculations change between transaction submission and execution.
attackPath: Monitor mempool for large claim transactions
Front-run with transactions that affect exchange rates or reward state
Victim's claim executes at unfavorable rates
recommendation: Add minOutput parameter to claim() allowing users to specify minimum acceptable rewards. Revert if actual output is below the threshold.
